newsitem.title: POLAND: High winds kill four people in Poland.
newsitem.headline: High winds kill four people in Poland.

text.p: Strong winds killed four people in Poland on Friday, newspapers reported on Saturday.
Rzeczpospolita newspaper reported that a building worker was crushed under a collapsing wall in western Poland, while a woman in the northwest was hit by a trapdoor falling from a roof.
In central Poland, winds caused a car accident in which two died.
The winds, with gusts up to 120 kms (75 miles) an hour, cut energy and telephone lines and toppled trees.
Similar storms on March 28 killed at least 10 people.
